tell me about Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)

The Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) at East West University plays a vital role in modern civilization, impacting almost all aspects of human life. The department offers a B.Sc. program in EEE aimed at producing engineering leaders who are compassionate and ethical members of society. 

The vision statement of the department is to create excellent engineers instilled with quality education, human values, and professional ethics [Page 127, Source: ewuundergraduate-bulletin-14th-edition-doc-version.pdf].

The B.Sc. in EEE program is accredited by the Board of Accreditation for Engineering and Technical Education (BAETE) under the Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh (IEB) [Page 55, Source: Doc1.pdf].
